rules: Sent only after the registration is stored and the response is committed (BR-07, AC-005-05), asynchronously; a failure is logged with the registration id only and never changes the registration (D-07).
Plain text only, no HTML: user input cannot inject markup (SR-05).
Addresses are parsed as single RFC 5322 addresses; user input never contains CR or LF (rejected by validation), so it cannot inject headers (SR-05).
{conferenceName} is CONFERENCE_NAME; option names are the display names at acceptance, grouped as Workshops, Events, Meals, Other activities.
No internal fields (database ids other than the registration id, normalized email, stack traces) appear in any email (SR-07).

messages.subject: Registration confirmed: {conferenceName}
bodyContains: each selected option name under its category heading, or 'No options selected'

messages.to: every address in ORGANIZER_EMAILS, in one message
messages.subject: New registration: {conferenceName}
bodyContains: every participant field with its label
each selected option name under its category heading
each consent given with its timestamp

attachments.content: the raw JSON copy, byte-identical to the stored file (registration-copy.schema.json)
